scope: Shampoo physical-property baselines and read-only skin/eye ingredient-domain audit
features: 18 as-supplied commercial ingredient mass percentages; no renormalization of known ingredients

targets.stability: Observed short-term phase stability: both pre-titration and 36 h post-titration inspections
targets.viscosity_100: log10 viscosity in mPa.s at 100 s^-1, log-log interpolation strictly within measured flow-curve range; observed stable samples only
targets.turbidity: log10(1 + proxy NTU); observed stable samples only

primary_evaluation: 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold grouped by exact set of nonzero commercial ingredient IDs; repeats with fixed seeds; same outer folds for all tasks and models
secondary_evaluation: Leave one polymer-thickener subsystem out, including any missing-component subsystem as its own group
curve_quality_rule: Conservative first baseline: exclude the viscosity target of an entire flow curve containing any nonpositive/nonfinite viscosity or shear value, duplicate shear rates, or lacking coverage of 100 s^-1. Keep other valid outcomes for that formulation. No extrapolation.
selection: No hyperparameter search. Extra Trees fixed before evaluation; baselines retained regardless of result. Repeated-CV SD is not a confidence interval.
source_data_use: Skin and eye composition/structure coverage and ingredient similarity audit only. No toxicity labels are used as physical-property labels or candidate ground truth.
prediction_limits: Regression conditional on observed stable formulations
Commercial stocks and polymers are not fully specified pure molecules
No causal or formulation safety claims
